goal: Prevent losing block-relay-only anchor peers when a node cleanly shuts down with networking disabled
Maintains eclipse attack resilience when the node restarts and reconnects to the network
agreement: Strong support because preserving anchors across restarts maintains eclipse resilience (willcl-ark)
Support noting low risk and avoidance of unnecessary anchor loss (danielabrozzoni)
Prior objections on races and anchor handling were resolved (luke-jr, danielabrozzoni, willcl-ark, w0xlt)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it stops anchor peer data from being wiped on shutdown while offline
Avoids degrading eclipse attack resilience for nodes restarting after being offline
